sn35.111:1.1: “Bhikkhus, without directly knowing and fully understanding the eye, without developing dispassion towards it and abandoning it, one is incapable of destroying suffering.
sn35.111:1.2: Without directly knowing and fully understanding the ear …
sn35.111:1.6: the mind, without developing dispassion towards it and abandoning it, one is incapable of destroying suffering.
sn35.111:1.7: But by directly knowing and fully understanding the eye …
sn35.111:1.10: the mind, by developing dispassion towards it and abandoning it, one is capable of destroying suffering.”
